column1: #   immutable SHA<TAB>reviewed signed source SHA<TAB>exact source signer email
#   immutable SHA<TAB>reviewed signed head SHA<TAB>exact source signer email<TAB>reviewed source parent SHA<TAB>immutable parent SHA
# This ledger is only for protected, shipped history that cannot be rewritten. The checker
# requires full lowercase SHAs, one row per immutable commit, and a real source commit with the
# exact declared @mail.build trailer. A three-field squash must be single-parent and tree-identical
# to its source. A five-field advanced-base squash must satisfy the stricter patch-equivalence and
# synthetic-tree contract. A merge must have exactly two parents, reference its reviewed second
# parent as source, and match the clean synthetic merge tree exactly.
